title: Label-Free Threshold Calibration and Label Efficiency in One-Class SCADA Anomaly Detection
description: Code, configurations, retained numerical results, and figure data for a reproducible cross-domain benchmark of one-class SCADA anomaly detection. The study evaluates labelled versus normal-only threshold calibration, point-wise and event-level metrics, attack-label budgets, and chronological versus stratified-random splits on BATADAL, Gas Pipeline, and HAI 22.04. Raw third-party datasets are not redistributed.
